question: Ayushman Bharat scheme provides health cover (per family per year) of:
explanation:
• Ayushman Bharat - PMJAY provides Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary/tertiary care.
• One of the largest health insurance schemes.

question: Indian Nursing Council (INC) was established under which Act?
explanation:
• INC was established by the Indian Nursing Council Act, 1947.
• It regulates nursing education and standards.

question: Who was the first woman President of India?
explanation:
• Pratibha Patil was the first woman President of India (2007-2012).
• Indira Gandhi was PM, not President.

question: Article 21 of the Indian Constitution deals with:
options: B. Right to life and personal liberty
explanation:
• Article 21: Protection of life and personal liberty. No person shall be deprived except by procedure established by law.
• Has been expanded to include health, dignity, etc.

question: International Nurses Day is celebrated on:
explanation:
• May 12 is Florence Nightingale's birthday—celebrated as International Nurses Day.
• Theme changes every year.

question: Capital of Nepal is:
explanation:
• Kathmandu is the capital of Nepal.
• Thimphu = Bhutan; Dhaka = Bangladesh; Colombo = Sri Lanka.

question: GDP stands for:
explanation:
• GDP = Gross Domestic Product—total value of goods and services produced in a country in a period.
• Key economic indicator.

question: National Health Mission (NHM) subsumes:
explanation:
• NHM includes National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) and National Urban Health Mission (NUHM).
• Aims at universal access to healthcare.

question: First Indian to win Nobel Prize in Medicine/Physiology:
explanation:
• Har Gobind Khorana (Indian-American) shared Nobel in Physiology or Medicine 1968.
• C.V. Raman: Physics; Tagore: Literature.

question: Budget in India is presented in Parliament by:
explanation:
• Union Budget is presented by the Finance Minister in Parliament.
• Usually on February 1.

question: WHO headquarters is in:
explanation:
• WHO is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
• UN agency for international health.

question: Right to Education (RTE) is under Article:
explanation:
• Article 21A: Right to free and compulsory education for children 6-14 years.
• Added by 86th Amendment.

question: National Florence Nightingale Award is given for:
explanation:
• National Florence Nightingale Award: recognition for nursing personnel.
• Given by President of India.

question: Capital of Bangladesh:
explanation:
• Dhaka is the capital of Bangladesh.
• Kathmandu = Nepal; Colombo = Sri Lanka.

question: RBI stands for:
explanation:
• RBI = Reserve Bank of India. Central bank; monetary policy, currency.
• Regulates banks.

question: Swachh Bharat Abhiyan aims at:
options: B. Open defecation free India, solid waste management, sanitation
explanation:
• Swachh Bharat: ODF, solid waste management, sanitation, behavior change.
• Launched 2014.

question: First nurse to receive Nobel Prize (Peace):
explanation:
• Mother Teresa received Nobel Peace Prize 1979 for humanitarian work.
• Florence Nightingale did not receive Nobel.

question: Lok Sabha has how many members (max)?
options: B. 552 (530 from states, 20 from UTs, 2 nominated)
explanation:
• Lok Sabha: max 552 (530 states + 20 UTs + 2 Anglo-Indian nominated). Current 543 elected.
• Lower house of Parliament.

question: Poshan Abhiyan is related to:
explanation:
• Poshan Abhiyan: National Nutrition Mission; reduce stunting, anemia, low birth weight.
• Focus on first 1000 days.

question: India's first woman Prime Minister:
explanation:
• Indira Gandhi was India's first woman Prime Minister (1966-77, 1980-84).
• Pratibha Patil was first woman President.

question: UNICEF stands for:
options: A. United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund
B. United Nations Children's Fund (current name)
explanation:
• UNICEF: United Nations Children's Fund. Works for child rights, health, education.
• Originally 'International Children's Emergency Fund'.

question: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) is part of:
explanation:
• PM-JAY is the health insurance component of Ayushman Bharat.
• Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary/tertiary care.

question: Indian state with longest coastline:
explanation:
• Gujarat has the longest coastline in India (~1600 km).
• Followed by Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu.

question: NFHS stands for:
explanation:
• NFHS = National Family Health Survey. Provides data on health, nutrition, family planning.
• Conducted by IIPS.

question: Fundamental Rights are in Part ___ of Constitution:
explanation:
• Fundamental Rights: Part III (Articles 12-35).
• Part IV = Directive Principles.

question: World Health Day is on:
explanation:
• World Health Day: April 7 (WHO founding). Theme each year.
• May 12 = International Nurses Day.

question: First Indian in space:
explanation:
• Rakesh Sharma was the first Indian in space (1984, Soviet mission).
• Kalpana Chawla: first Indian-origin woman in space.

question: GDP growth rate indicates:
options: B. Rate of increase in value of goods and services produced
explanation:
• GDP growth rate: how fast economy is growing (year-on-year or quarter).
• Key indicator of economic health.

question: Mission Indradhanush aims at:
explanation:
• Mission Indradhanush: immunize all children and pregnant women (full immunization).
• Intensified drive for missed doses.

question: Rajya Sabha is:
options: B. Upper house of Parliament (Council of States)
explanation:
• Rajya Sabha: Upper house; represents states; 250 members (238 elected + 12 nominated).
• Permanent body; not dissolved.
